general.temas: Se repiten las interrupciones del tráfico aéreo y sus causas, la situación de Nvidia y su relación con la Administración Trump, y las nominaciones a los Grammy. También aparecen el avance demócrata en los estados y los retos de la educación superior. Solo The Wall Street Journal destaca la pérdida del estatus de eliminación del sarampión en Estados Unidos.
general.motivo_crispacion: La crispación es moderada por las disputas sobre las políticas de la Administración Trump y las acusaciones de falta de inversión que el secretario de Transporte dirige al Congreso y a gobiernos anteriores. También generan tensión los cambios de poder demócrata en los estados, con posibles consecuencias para los vales escolares, y el debate sobre Nvidia y China. En el ámbito internacional destacan los bombardeos rusos sobre Ucrania. Las noticias sobre los Grammy, el ocio y la recuperación de los vuelos ofrecen un contrapunto menos conflictivo.

noticias.titulo: Trump Administration Moves to Close A.I. Chip Loophole Ahead of China Trip
noticias.entradilla: The rules, a topic of fierce debate in the administration, could cut back on Nvidia’s sales to foreign data centers serving Chinese companies.

noticias.titulo: Is Jensen Huang Plotting a Comeback?
noticias.entradilla: Prominent figures in Silicon Valley want to see Jensen Huang reinstalled as Nvidia’s boss. Some in the Trump administration don’t want him to return.

noticias.titulo: What’s Behind Back-to-Back Meltdowns at the F.A.A. and Microsoft
noticias.entradilla: Plus, why “birdbrain” is a misnomer.

noticias.titulo: Winter Nightmare Looms Early in Ukraine as Russia Strikes Relentlessly
noticias.entradilla: Even as it talks peace, Russia has opened a bombing campaign intended to strip Kyiv and other cities of heat, running water and sanitation this winter.

noticias.titulo: Permitting Bill Would Charge Data Centers Billions for Power
noticias.entradilla: The permitting bill could make it easier to build data centers for A.I. but a novel provision would also force data centers to pay much more for power.

noticias.titulo: What Nithya Raman Plans to Do First as L.A. Mayor
noticias.entradilla: Once she takes office, she pledges to use metrics to deliver “a city that works” after a pandemic, wildfires and clashes with Trump. But budget constraints and more stand in the way.

noticias.titulo: Democrats Will Wield Enormous Power in Statehouses. What Will They Do?
noticias.entradilla: While attention has focused on the incoming Democratic Congress, the real change could happen in state capitals where Democrats will control a dozen new statehouse chambers.

noticias.titulo: Airstrikes on Iran Missile Sites May Shed Light on Justification for Dams
noticias.entradilla: Environmentalists have long puzzled over a wide network of water projects lacking any obvious justification. Then their areas were targeted in airstrikes.

noticias.titulo: Raye, Rosalía and Ella Langley Top a Women-Led 2027 Grammys Field
noticias.entradilla: Langley is the first straight-up country artist to contend for the top album prize in eight years, and Raye’s 11 nods lead all nominees.

noticias.titulo: Grammy Nominations 2027: See the Full List
noticias.entradilla: The artists, albums and songs up for honors at the 69th annual ceremony were announced Monday. The show will be held on Feb. 7 in Los Angeles and air on ABC and Disney+ after decades on CBS.

noticias.titulo: How Could a Router Lead to a Nationwide Ground Stop?
noticias.entradilla: Aviation experts and federal officials said the network outage began after a new piece of networking equipment began flooding the rest of the system with data. The underlying cause is unclear.

noticias.titulo: How Sam Bankman-Fried Lost Out on a $35 Billion Jackpot From Anthropic
noticias.entradilla: The founder of the collapsed FTX crypto exchange, who is serving prison time for fraud, would have made a windfall from a $500 million investment in Anthropic.

analisis.resumen:
- La Administración Trump estudia restringir las ventas de chips de Nvidia vinculadas a China; otro proyecto elevaría el coste eléctrico de los centros de datos.
- Rusia intensifica los ataques contra Ucrania mientras habla de paz; en Irán se examina la posible relación entre presas y sitios de misiles atacados.
- La futura alcaldesa de Los Ángeles expone sus prioridades, y los demócratas ganan poder en legislaturas estatales.
- Una avería de red provocó la suspensión nacional de vuelos; también se abordan problemas en Microsoft y la inversión de Sam Bankman-Fried en Anthropic.
- Raye, Rosalía y Ella Langley destacan entre las nominadas a los Grammy de 2027.
analisis.motivo_populismo: Expresiones como «pesadilla invernal», «colapsos» y «¿trama un regreso?» aportan dramatismo, aunque predominan los titulares informativos y no se aprecia una apelación al pueblo contra las élites.
analisis.sesgo: La selección presta especial atención a las decisiones de la Administración Trump, la tecnología y sus efectos económicos y políticos. Algunos titulares adoptan un enfoque crítico o dramático, sin que se aprecie una orientación partidista inequívoca en el conjunto.

noticias.titulo: Flights gradually return to normal after days of disruption
noticias.entradilla: Airlines said they expected to operate a largely normal flight schedule on Monday, after Friday’s nationwide ground stop led to widespread delays.

noticias.titulo: Private school vouchers at risk in some states as Democrats gain control
noticias.entradilla: Democrats, who mostly oppose vouchers, gained power in five of the six states that spend the most money on voucher programs. The power shift may reverse years of steady expansion.

noticias.titulo: The serious complications of GLP-1s that few may know about
noticias.entradilla: With millions of patients taking GLP-1 drugs, doctors are discovering rare but worrying problems affecting the body and the mind.

noticias.titulo: Still too young to buy beer, these teens are winning elected office
noticias.entradilla: Victories for local and statewide offices across the country signal Gen Z’s political engagement is on the rise, experts say.

noticias.titulo: A failed execution, a shrinking death row and a historic moment for capital punishment
noticias.entradilla: What Christa Pike’s botched execution, Gavin Newsom’s emptying of California’s death row and a return to firing squads could mean for capital punishment in America.

noticias.titulo: Colonial Williamsburg unveils $600 million upgrade for its 100th birthday
noticias.entradilla: The five-year plan will expand the outdoor history museum’s scope and add new facilities.

noticias.titulo: Trump’s stake in Nvidia grew to as much as $62 million before scandal broke out
noticias.entradilla: The president benefited from the firm’s success, disclosures show. The value of his holdings rose dramatically as his administration let Nvidia sell advanced chips in China.

noticias.titulo: Memorial opens to victims of 2015 mass shooting at Charleston church
noticias.entradilla: The memorial invites visitors to reflect on the massacre within the congregation’s long history of hardship, resilience and forgiveness.

noticias.titulo: Duffy blames Congress, prior administrations for air travel halt, chaos
noticias.entradilla: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy refused to apologize for failures that led to the nationwide ground stop, pointing to a lack of investment in air traffic modernization.

noticias.titulo: Costco recalls whipped cream over potential cleaning chemical contamination
noticias.entradilla: A batch of a Kirkland whipped cream product sold in 12 states has been withdrawn after customers reported “a chemical smell and taste."

noticias.titulo: Airlines scramble to resume flights after ground stop as cancellations continue
noticias.entradilla: The Federal Aviation Administration said flight schedules are expected to return to normal by late Sunday, though some airlines warned that disruptions could persist.

noticias.titulo: Game wardens once crossed property lines. A legal movement is stopping them.
noticias.entradilla: A growing property rights campaign is reshaping how states police hunting and protect animals.

analisis.resumen:
- Los vuelos se recuperan gradualmente tras la suspensión nacional, aunque persisten cancelaciones; el secretario de Transporte culpa al Congreso y a gobiernos anteriores.
- Los avances demócratas en varios estados podrían poner en riesgo los vales para escuelas privadas.
- Se examinan el aumento del valor de las acciones de Nvidia en manos de Trump y el auge de jóvenes elegidos para cargos públicos.
- La portada aborda complicaciones poco frecuentes de los fármacos GLP-1, la retirada de nata montada y el futuro de la pena de muerte.
- También recoge la reforma de Colonial Williamsburg, un memorial en Charleston y una campaña por los derechos de propiedad que limita la actuación de los guardas de caza.
analisis.motivo_populismo: Predomina un tono informativo, aunque expresiones como «caos», «escándalo» y «complicaciones graves que pocos conocen» aportan dramatismo y cierto sensacionalismo.
analisis.sesgo: La selección presta atención crítica a decisiones y responsabilidades de autoridades públicas, en particular sobre el transporte aéreo y las acciones de Nvidia de Trump. No se aprecia una orientación ideológica inequívoca en el conjunto de los titulares.

noticias.titulo: Mamdani Disbands Controversial NYPD Protest Unit
noticias.entradilla: The Democratic socialist had faced increasing pressure to dismantle a group tasked with making arrests during demonstrations.

noticias.titulo: Trump Administration Can’t Close D.C. Golf Course for Now, Judge Rules
noticias.entradilla: Officials had hoped to shutter it starting Sunday, but groups challenged plans to transform the public site into a championship-level course

noticias.titulo: Christian Schools, Big Universities Try to Fight Race-Discrimination Rule
noticias.entradilla: The IRS proposal would let the government revoke the tax-exempt status of schools engaging in racial preferences.

noticias.titulo: Weekend Air Travel Woes Mount After FAA Lifts Nationwide Ground Stop
noticias.entradilla: The disruption is still expected to create travel problems that persist through the weekend.

noticias.titulo: News Quiz for Nov. 14, 2026
noticias.entradilla: Test your knowledge of the week’s events with The Wall Street Journal News Quiz.

noticias.titulo: U.S. Loses Measles-Elimination Status as Historic Resurgence Sickens Thousands
noticias.entradilla: The Pan American Health Organization has revoked the coveted status, people familiar with the matter said—a stunning reversal for a country that for decades has kept the vaccine-preventable disease at bay.

noticias.titulo: The Parents Suing Schools Because Their Kids Got Bad Grades
noticias.entradilla: In Silicon Valley and beyond, families are pressuring teachers or calling lawyers over classroom clashes, from a recess squabble to an essay flagged as “76% AI.”

noticias.titulo: Cold Plunges, Fitness Pop-Ups: The Students Pushing Clean Living on Campus
noticias.entradilla: Gone are the days of instant ramen and all-nighters. Today’s undergrads are maximizing their protein, tracking their sleep and obsessing over hydration.

noticias.titulo: Cornell Faculty Rebuke President Over Response to Sex-Assault Allegations
noticias.entradilla: The no-confidence vote, while largely symbolic, reflects dissatisfaction with the university leadership’s response.

noticias.titulo: The Unlikely College Football Powerhouse Fueled by Texas Gas Money
noticias.entradilla: Tarleton State University might not be a household name. But the school is pouring money into its athletics department to change that.

noticias.titulo: Colleges Struggle to Stop ‘Melt’: Students Who Commit, Then Don’t Show Up
noticias.entradilla: Some students switch after placing deposits at multiple schools; others don’t attend anywhere because of financial challenges.

noticias.titulo: California Voters Pass Ban on Wealth Taxes
noticias.entradilla: The passage of the billionaire-funded ballot measure follows the failure of a high-profile billionaire tax.

analisis.resumen:
- Mamdani disuelve una polémica unidad policial de protestas; un juez frena por ahora el cierre de un campo de golf público en Washington.
- Escuelas cristianas y grandes universidades intentan combatir una propuesta fiscal sobre preferencias raciales; California aprueba prohibir los impuestos sobre el patrimonio.
- Estados Unidos pierde su estatus de eliminación del sarampión tras un repunte que ha enfermado a miles de personas.
- Los problemas del transporte aéreo continuarán durante el fin de semana pese al levantamiento de una suspensión nacional de vuelos.
- Varias noticias abordan conflictos escolares, hábitos universitarios, financiación deportiva y dificultades para retener a estudiantes admitidos.
analisis.motivo_populismo: Predomina un tono informativo, aunque expresiones como «repunte histórico», «sorprendente revés» y «aumentan los problemas» aportan dramatismo; no se aprecia una apelación al pueblo contra las élites.
analisis.sesgo: La selección presta especial atención a conflictos legales, decisiones públicas y problemas de instituciones educativas. El enfoque es principalmente institucional y de actualidad, sin que se aprecie una orientación partidista clara en el conjunto.

noticias.titulo: 2027 Grammy nominations: Raye, Rosalía and a 100th nod for Beyoncé
noticias.entradilla: The two ambitious European artists are nominated for projects that explore high-flown ideas about faith, love and family amid complicated orchestral arrangements. Beyoncé also received her 100th career nod.

noticias.titulo: Here's the complete list of 2027 Grammy nominees
noticias.entradilla: Raye led the 2027 Grammy Award nominations and is tied with Beyoncé's record for the most nominations in a single year by a female artist. Here's the complete list of nominees.

noticias.titulo: Grammy nominations snubs and surprises: Lots of love for Madonna while Harry Styles gets shut out
noticias.entradilla: From country music's crossover hit of the century to the Spanish avant-garde, this year's top Grammy categories stood out for being dominated by women, and the range of genres they excelled in.

noticias.titulo: A $470,000 machine was supposed to detect pesticides in legal weed. Labs say it failed badly
noticias.entradilla: Many labs have sued PerkinElmer, complaining of the QSight's failure to reliably detect pesticides such as captan, chlorfenapyr and chlordane, which can cause cancer and nervous system damage.

noticias.titulo: After coyote attack on toddler, some Westchester residents fear they could be next
noticias.entradilla: Missing cats and backyard sightings have sparked anxiety among some residents over coyotes in Westchester. As they call for intervention, an under-resourced L.A. Animal Services says people are often the problem.

noticias.titulo: First a death, then hoax threats. Attendance plunged after Franklin High tragedy, data reveal
noticias.entradilla: The decline in attendance — and another one days later — underlined the trauma after a student died in plunge from fourth floor.

noticias.titulo: 'Morning Joe' co-anchor Willie Geist is leaving MS NOW
noticias.entradilla: Geist will expand his role at NBC News where he is host of "Sunday Today"

noticias.titulo: California loses international students at twice the U.S. rate
noticias.entradilla: California lost its lead to New York as international student enrollment fell faster than the national rate. Trump's visa restrictions and proposed international student fees have added uncertainty as colleges report further declines this fall.

noticias.titulo: The L.A. mayor's race is over. Now the scramble is on for elected L.A. County executive
noticias.entradilla: Horvath has already declared for L.A. County executive. Who will be next? Garcetti, Caruso, Harris-Dawson, Hahn, Richardson and Rodriguez are in the conversation.

noticias.titulo: The loops of Los Angeles: Cursive is fading, and so are the city's midcentury cursive signs
noticias.entradilla: Rae's in Santa Monica, Johnie's in Miracle Mile, Bob's Big Boy Broiler in Downey. Some signs still remain, reminders of a future that is now past.

noticias.titulo: Elizabeth Holmes' partner Billy Evans breaks silence after A24 documentary backlash
noticias.entradilla: Billy Evans, longtime partner of convicted fraudster Elizabeth Holmes, won't speak poorly of Amanda Seyfried, who called him disrespectful of her and Holmes. In his first interview since the theatrical release of "You Can See Everything," Evans addresses villainous portrayal.

noticias.titulo: How to have the best Sunday in L.A., according to Vanna White
noticias.entradilla: Hiking, French toast and crochet are on the schedule for the 'Wheel of Fortune' fixture.

analisis.resumen:
- Los Grammy dominan la portada: destacan Raye, Rosalía y la nominación número 100 de Beyoncé.
- Varios laboratorios demandan por los fallos de una máquina de detección de pesticidas en cannabis.
- La portada recoge el temor a los coyotes en Westchester y la caída de asistencia tras una tragedia escolar.
- California pierde estudiantes internacionales a un ritmo superior al nacional; también comienza la carrera por el cargo ejecutivo del condado de Los Ángeles.
- Otras noticias abordan televisión, cultura local, Elizabeth Holmes y planes de ocio en Los Ángeles.
analisis.motivo_populismo: Expresiones como «falló estrepitosamente», el temor a ser la próxima víctima y las «sorpresas y ausencias» de los Grammy aportan dramatismo, pero no se aprecia una oposición entre pueblo y élites.
analisis.sesgo: La selección tiene un marcado enfoque local en Los Ángeles y California, junto con un peso notable del entretenimiento. No se aprecia una orientación política partidista clara.

noticias.titulo: Gypsy Rose Blanchard’s partner Ken Urker’s cause of death revealed
noticias.entradilla: Urker was found unresponsive in his bed at his Raceland, Louisiana, home on Oct. 1, on his 34th birthday.

noticias.titulo: Gypsy Rose Blanchard’s partner Ken Urker’s cause of death revealed
noticias.entradilla: Urker was found unresponsive in his bed at his Raceland, Louisiana, home on Oct. 1, on his 34th birthday.

noticias.titulo: Child, 5, plunges to their death out of second-floor window at Los Angeles home
noticias.entradilla: Los Angeles Police Department officers responded to the incident near Boyle Avenue and Whittier Boulevard, where the child had fallen from a second-floor window.

noticias.titulo: $55K cash mysteriously dumped in Maine going to hot cause: ‘Literally a find in the woods’
noticias.entradilla: “This was a true gift for our community and one that literally fell in our lap.”

noticias.titulo: Trump says he ‘may meet’ North Korea’s Kim Jong Un in China
noticias.entradilla: President Trump said Monday that he “may” meet with North Korean dictator Kim Jong Un during his upcoming visit to China — where he’s already set to hold a three-way summit with Russia’s Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

noticias.titulo: Trump ‘would not mind’ Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO, doesn’t know if mistress is a Chinese spy
noticias.entradilla: Huang stepped down Friday following revelations of a series of extramarital affairs.

noticias.titulo: Even 10-year-old mattress stains are no match for this shopper-loved cleaning gadget, now 20% off
noticias.entradilla: Cleaning made easy.

noticias.titulo: Inside Fanatics’ Michael Rubin surprise proposal that stunned longtime girlfriend  — ‘didn’t know he had it in him!’
noticias.entradilla: Fanatics mogul Michael Rubin saved his best surprise for his artist girlfriend Camille Fishel last week when he popped the question in Los Cabos, Mexico.

noticias.titulo: ‘Slow Horses’ renewed for Seasons 9 and 10
noticias.entradilla: The strange, strange game continues!

noticias.titulo: Small-town teacher breaks down as she admits sex with student, 16, she shared nudes with
noticias.entradilla: The married mom wept as she admitted the depraved charges as part of a plea deal expected to see her sentenced to five years in prison.

noticias.titulo: Tanker that collided with New Orleans cruise ship had failed steering: officials
noticias.entradilla: 32 people were sent to the hospital following the crash.

noticias.titulo: Russell Brand’s ‘appalling’ prison message being ‘urgently investigated’ by UK authorities after wife Laura shared rape denial
noticias.entradilla: In the message, relayed by Laura, the comedian said "something strange is happening" as he "is not guilty for the offenses [he has] been jailed for."

analisis.resumen:
- Se anuncia la causa de la muerte de Ken Urker, pareja de Gypsy Rose Blanchard; la noticia aparece duplicada.
- Un niño de cinco años murió tras caer de una ventana en Los Ángeles.
- Trump plantea una posible reunión con Kim Jong Un y comenta la salida del director de Nvidia.
- Una profesora admitió haber mantenido relaciones sexuales con un alumno; autoridades británicas investigan un mensaje de Russell Brand.
- Un fallo de dirección precedió a la colisión de un petrolero con un crucero en Nueva Orleans; también destacan noticias de celebridades, ocio y consumo.
analisis.motivo_populismo: Abundan el sensacionalismo y términos emotivos como «depraved» o «stunned», aunque apenas hay apelaciones al pueblo contra las élites.
analisis.sesgo: La selección prioriza sucesos trágicos, escándalos y celebridades, con un enfoque orientado al impacto emocional. En las noticias políticas no se aprecia una orientación partidista clara a partir de estos titulares.
